title: Can MV mac projects run on/be transferred to Windows?

posts.author: Goblinoid
posts.body:
I already posted this question on the RPG maker subreddit but to no avail as I haven't received any replies. Gonna try posting it here instead.
I’ve spent countless hours on a making a game in RPG maker MV on my mac; it wasn’t until quite recently that I realised support for future macOS was discontinued back in 2021 (that explains the constant crashes I’ve had while playtesting, oops). I’m therefore planning on transferring and continuing development on the same project on a PC instead but I’m unsure if there’s a way to do so. Is there?
(I sincerely hope that all I have to do is transfer the project folder to PC and everything else will work out smoothly so long as I have the .exe file).
Any help is appreciated thanks.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Your project files are your project files - just copy them to the Windows computer.
The
editor
is coded differently between operating systems, and your deployed game is deployed differently depending on which operating system you select, but the actual project is agnostic.

posts.author: Piyan Glupak
posts.body: Your events and any Javascript or plugins that you used will work as well. [Never used RPG Maker on a Mac myself, so you could always let us know how well things work with transferring your project to confirm or refute my opinion.]
